PART III - LANDS
Title Registration
REGISTRATION OF TITLE ACT, No. 21 OF 1998
Declaration of Determination of the Commissioner of Title Settlement under Section 14

BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the title to parcel of Land No. 157 of Block 02, con-tained in the Cadastral Map No. 620122, situated in the Village of Koongasthanna, within the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 239 A - Koongasthanna in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Waligopolla, in the District of Rathnapura, in the Province of Sabaragamuwa, referred to in Notice calling for claims to land parcels which was duly published in the Gazette No. 2070/36 of 11th May, 2018 in terms of Section 55 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998. K.A.K. RANJITH DHARMAPALA, Commissioner of Title Settlement. Land Title Settlement Department, No. 1200/6, “Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road, Battaramulla. 29th August, 2018
No. 2089/8– MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 17, 2018
N.B.– This Extraordinary Gazette can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
